suggestions.now: Fires when an artifact needs cross-examination before it persists. *Don't touch the file until I say 'lock it in.' Ask three questions at a time. Push back when my answer is generic.* The lock-in protects the file. The batching keeps the dialog efficient. The push-back instruction tells the agent to drop the niceness tax. Reach for it where a gap has already cost you a re-run, not by default: the extra round of questions is certain, the saving is not.
